metadata.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION OUTPUT. Generated from fabricated test fixtures. These are NOT real satellite observations, NOT real Punjab boundaries and NOT real district data. Do not use for enforcement, reporting or any operational decision.
metadata.interpretation: risk_score is a heuristic verification-priority score for scheduling field checks; it is NOT a probability of burning or of undetected fire. observed_fire_count counts satellite detections only. Zero detections do not prove zero burning: cloud or smoke cover, overpass timing and small or short-lived fires all cause missed detections, so low priority does not prove no burning. risk_score is null (risk_level 'unknown') when the available evidence is insufficient.

grid.assignment_rule: pixel centre, half-open cells [x0,x0+size) x [y0,y0+size) in the projected CRS; each detection counted at most once

district_attribution.method: district with the largest area overlap with the cell

metadata.verification_status_note: All cells are emitted as 'unverified'; field verification is recorded by the backend.

components.name: observed_detections
components.description: VIIRS detections in the analysis window; 5 or more saturates the component.

components.name: historical_recurrence
components.description: Recurrence across earlier seasons (calendar years before the window): each season's VIIRS detections are capped at 5, then averaged over the seasons covered, so no single active season dominates.

components.name: cropland_fraction
components.description: Share of the cell classified as cropland (0-1), general cropland coverage, not paddy-specific; e.g. ESA WorldCover class 40 via prepare-cropland. Tie-break only: orders equal scores among cells with recent or historical fire evidence and never changes risk_score or risk_level.

scoring.ordering: risk_score descending; equal scores among cells with fire evidence ordered by cropland_fraction descending; then cell_id. Written as priority_rank (1 = first) on every scored feature.
